Name: Struggling_Student
Observations: Shows difficulty focusing during lessons and often appears distracted. Needs frequent reminders to stay on task. Struggles with following multi-step instructions. Shows frustration when tasks become challenging but responds well to individual attention and encouragement.

Name: Improving_Student
Observations: Initially shy and reluctant to participate but shows gradual improvement with consistent encouragement. Beginning to raise hand occasionally during discussions. Shows interest in hands-on activities and learns better through practical demonstrations.

Name: Progressing_Student
Observations: Demonstrates steady improvement in academic performance over the past month. Shows increased confidence when answering questions in class. Beginning to help other students with basic tasks. Responds positively to praise and recognition.

Name: Advanced_Student
Observations: Consistently demonstrates high academic performance across all subjects. Shows leadership qualities and often helps struggling classmates without being asked. Demonstrates creativity in problem-solving and suggests innovative approaches to learning activities.

Name: Challenged_Student
Observations: Faces significant learning challenges but shows determination and persistence. Works harder than most students to achieve basic goals. Shows improvement in social skills and has formed positive friendships. Responds well to modified learning approaches and visual aids.

Name: Motivated_Student
Observations: Shows exceptional motivation and enthusiasm for learning despite facing personal challenges at home. Arrives early and stays late to complete assignments. Demonstrates resilience and positive attitude. Inspires other students through dedication and hard work.

Name: Talented_Student
Observations: Demonstrates exceptional abilities in multiple areas including academics, arts, and sports. Shows maturity beyond years and often takes on mentoring roles. Balances high achievement with humility and kindness towards all classmates.

Name: Developing_Student
Observations: Shows steady development in both academic and social skills. Demonstrates improved behavior and self-control compared to earlier assessments. Beginning to take on leadership roles in small group activities. Shows increased empathy and consideration for others.
